Privacy

The Echo Archives keeps the data footprint small. This page explains the information used for browsing, chat, ratings, submissions, and maintainer review.

Back to previous page Cookie details

Small footprint

No ad-tech tracking or analytics scripts are used in the current public site.

Local memory

Chat history and anonymous rating identity stay browser-scoped unless you submit a form.

Manual review

Submissions are stored for archive review, moderation, and necessary follow-up.

Privacy map
Browser storage Server submissions Contact details Cookies External services

This page reflects the current implementation, not a generic policy template.

What the site stores in your browser

The Ask the Archivist panel keeps recent conversation history in session storage so it survives page refreshes during the same browser session.

Community ratings use a server-issued anonymous voter cookie so the same device can update or remove its own rating later without requiring an account.

What the server receives

When you submit a rating, correction, listener review, creator verification request, or new-show submission, the server receives the request body you send.

  • Rating writes may use Cloudflare Turnstile verification to reduce automated abuse.
  • Limited technical data such as salted IP and user-agent hashes may be used for moderation, abuse prevention, and rate limiting.
  • Submission content is reviewed before it affects the public archive.
  • The site does not currently run public analytics or advertising trackers.

Submissions and contact details

If you send a submission form with a contact email, that email is stored with the submission so the maintainer can review the request or follow up when necessary.

Do not send private information that is not relevant to the archive entry, correction, review, or verification request.

Cookies and maintainer access

Public browsing and chat do not currently require first-party application cookies. Community ratings use an HTTP-only voter cookie for accountless one-device voting, and the private maintainer review area may set an HTTP-only session cookie when maintainer authentication is enabled.

See the cookies and browser storage page for the practical storage list.

Third-party services and changes

The site links out to external listening platforms, official show sites, Patreon, GitHub, and other destinations chosen by the user. Community rating writes may also contact Cloudflare Turnstile for human-verification checks. Those services operate under their own privacy terms.

If the archive adds accounts, analytics, newsletters, or other personal-data features later, this page should be revised to match the live behavior instead of relying on boilerplate policy text.
